translationRepairs: One auditor and materials-check officer; one works officer who also commanded the moat camp; eighteen clerks; seventeen envoy clerks; five archive clerks; two seal keepers; three Mongol paiza scribes; one Muslim clerk; and one interpreter.

One auditor and materials-check officer; one works officer who also commanded the moat camp; eighteen clerks; seventeen envoy clerks; five archive clerks; two seal keepers; three Mongol bichigchi (scribes); one Muslim clerk; and one interpreter.
必闍赤 (bichigchi) means scribe/secretary, not "paiza" (牌子, a tablet of authority); the idiomatic rendering mistranslates the title.
Established in Zhiyuan 20 (1283), the posts were filled from the four imperial guards and ba'aturqachi.
Established in Zhiyuan 20 (1283), the posts were filled by balaqachi (city-gate wardens) drawn from the four keshig.
八剌哈赤 transcribes balaqachi (city-gate keepers), not "ba'aturqachi"; the source says the posts were filled by balaqachi of the four keshig, not by the guards plus another group.
The Fanzshan Timber-Harvesting Intendant's Office held rank 5b. It managed timber felling for chariots and other woodwork and produced zhisun belt plaques, knife hilts, and related items.
The Fanshan Timber-Harvesting Intendant's Office held rank 5b. It managed timber felling for chariots and other woodwork and produced zhisun belt plaques, knife hilts, and related items.
凡山 is romanized Fanshan; "Fanzshan" is a corrupted spelling.
The laborer-and-artisan offices for Fanzshan, Wanping, and other regions had two superintendents, two associate superintendents, and one superintendent overseeing timber-cart households.
The laborer-and-artisan offices for Fanshan, Wanping, and other regions had two superintendents, two associate superintendents, and one superintendent overseeing timber-cart households.
凡山 is romanized Fanshan; "Fanzshan" is a corrupted spelling.
The Armory Temple held rank 3a. It repaired weapons and also received and issued them.
The Court of the Armory (武備寺) held rank 3a. It repaired weapons and also received and issued them.
寺 here is a government court/agency (as in 太常寺), not a "temple"; "Armory Temple" mistranslates the agency name.
In year 21 the directorate became a temple coequal with the Court of Imperial Guards.
In year 21 the directorate was made a court (寺), coequal with the Court of Imperial Guards.
改監為寺 means the directorate was upgraded to a court (寺, an agency), not a "temple".
In Dade 11 it was promoted to a court.
In Dade 11 it was raised to the status of a yuan (院, a higher-ranking office).
升為院 refers to the higher 院 status; distinguishes it from 寺 ("court") so the sequence 監→寺→院→寺 is intelligible.
In Zhida 4 it was restored as a temple with officials as before.
In Zhida 4 it was restored as a court (寺) with officials as before.
復為寺 means it reverted to court (寺) status, not to a "temple".
The Liaohé River Region and Other Places Intendant's Office for Artisans of All Categories held rank 5b with one each of Darugachi, intendant, and associate intendant.
The Liao River Region and Other Places Intendant's Office for Artisans of All Categories held rank 5b with one each of Darugachi, intendant, and associate intendant.
遼河 is the Liao River; "Liaohé" carries a stray accent and duplicates "River".
In Zhida 4 it remained a temple.
In Zhida 4 it reverted to a court (寺).
仍為寺 after the Dade 11 upgrade to 院 means it went back to being a court (寺, an agency), not that it "remained a temple".
In Zhida 4 it was restored as a temple office.
In Zhida 4 it was restored as a court (寺).
復為寺 means restored to court (寺) status; 寺 here is a government agency, not a temple.
In year 4 it was restored as a temple office with five ministers; one vice minister was added, filled by a eunuch.
In year 4 it reverted to a court (寺) with five ministers; one vice minister was added, filled by a eunuch.
仍為寺 means it went back to court (寺) status after the Zhida 1 upgrade to 院; 寺 is a government agency, not a "temple office".

Court ministers: five posts at rank 3a;

潛邸 is the residence of a future emperor before his accession (a princely residence), not an "heir's residence".
In Yanyou 7 it reverted to rank 4a.
仍正四品 after the Yanyou 1 special promotion to 3a means it went back to 4a, not that it "remained" 4a.
